settings.label: Long items
settings.heading: Why a linear drain ships differently.
settings.body:
A drain up to a metre and a half long is oversized freight. That changes how it is packed, who can carry it and where it can be delivered — a street address rather than a parcel locker, and someone on site to receive it.

If your site has access restrictions or a delivery window, tell us when you order rather than after it has been dispatched.
